people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: Yahweh said to me, “Backsliding Israel has shown herself more righteous than treacherous Judah.
translations.bsb: And the LORD said to me, “Faithless Israel has shown herself more righteous than unfaithful Judah.
translations.kjv: And the LORD said unto me, The backsliding Israel hath justified herself more than treacherous Judah.
translations.asv: And Jehovah said unto me, Backsliding Israel hath showed herself more righteous than treacherous Judah.
